comments.author: @carlking3979
comments.text: I was born in Australia and have lived here for 83 years.  Very little of what you showed reflected my experiences of where I lived for the first 29.5 years in Brisbane, Queensland, and the remainder of my time in Logan City.  My house is actually less than 500 metres from the Brisbane border.  You showed no sport, none of the tertiary industry in which I worked from age 12 until 70.  You mentioned nothing of the large demographic of retired persons.  Approximately 16% of the Australian population is aged 65 and over. This percentage is expected to increase to nearly 20% by 2066.  But you did spend considerable time on the 3.8% of Australia's population identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander in the 2021 Census.  Whereas this is very politically correct, and no doubt gave you a feeling of self satisfaction, it does little to illustrate the reality of life in Australia.  No!  I'm not suggesting a reduction in that area; in fact more of why there is only 3.8%  should be said.  I could say a lot more, but I'm bored now.
